conformance_surfaces.role: Committed runtime implementation owning open-door forward-side crossing detection, shared crossing state/event exposure, and owner-controlled reset behavior.
Committed PlayMode conformance tests covering that opening/interaction alone does not mark crossing and that reaching the forward side of an open door does.

gate_results.notes: The Unity PlayMode results and log provide authoritative automated evidence at the validated commit that crossing is not set merely by interaction/opening and is set only after the wizard reaches the open door's forward side. HumanValidation-01 corroborates the delivered behavior but does not replace the automated evidence.

human_approval.notes: Proposal only; human approval remains required. Authoritative gate evidence is the passed hash-bound Unity PlayMode result and log. The human validation artifact is included only as corroborating delivery-review evidence, not as authoritative automated evidence.
